A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Let’s clear
things up.

What can you automate for my business?+

A good starting point is any repeatable task: moving information between tools, preparing content, organizing leads, or sending research updates. We’ll review your current process and choose a focused first workflow.

Do I need to understand AI or coding?+

No. Tell me what you do today and where it gets frustrating. I’ll explain the options in plain language and walk you through the finished setup.

Can we start with a small project?+

Absolutely. A single useful workflow or a focused landing page is a sensible place to begin. We’ll agree on the scope, deliverables, and cost before the work starts.

How long does a project take?+

It depends on the tools involved, the complexity of the workflow, and the content available. Once we’ve discussed your brief, I’ll propose a timeline that fits the actual scope.

Will I be able to manage it after handoff?+

The handoff includes a walkthrough of how your website or workflow works and what needs ongoing attention. We can also discuss support if you’d like help as your needs change.
